walkthroughs.body_html:
Strong: HCl, H2SO4, HNO3 - fully ionised.

Weak: ethanoic acid - partly ionised.

Strength!= concentration.

Acid + alkali: H+ + OH- -> H2O.

Precipitation: Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl.

2HCl + CaCO3 -> CaCl2 + H2O + CO2.

Effervescence is observed.
